sloka: श्रुतिमान्समदर्शी च व्रताचाररतस्तथा ।पितेव तपसा युक्तो ह्यभवद्विश्रवा मुनिः ।। ७.२.३४ ।।
transliteration: śrutimānsamadarśī ca vratācāraratastathā ।piteva tapasā yukto hyabhavadviśravā muniḥ ।। 7.2.34 ।।

translations.english: Sage Vishrava became learned in scriptures, impartial, devoted to vows and observances, and indeed, like his father, engaged in severe austerities. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वितीयः सर्गः ।। 2 ।। Thus ends the second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
